question: Can the locally cached pinned ViZDoom image start the installed Freedoom MAP01 target under a fresh WSLc container with a private Xvfb display?
change_from_a01: Mount the read-only evidence directory at /evidence instead of /study. The image declares /study/SOURCE as its working directory, so read-only mounting /study prevented container initialization before the application ran.
claim_boundary: Target construction smoke only. No agent-interface dispatch, external input, release, expiry, recovery, task-success, or efficiency claim.

target.engine: ViZDoom Python package bundled in pinned image

procedure: Run smoke_map01.py exactly once using xvfb-run. Initialize a new game on MAP01, record initial screen dimensions and SHA-256 plus initial HUD game variables, close normally, and retain stdout/stderr and exit status. No input event is sent.
allocation: Fresh uniquely named transient WSLc container; no existing container restarted or reused.
